title: Neighborhood Homes for All of Us Creates More Housing for Families and First-Time Buyers
description:
The City of San Diego is working to address the housing shortage and affordability crisis by making it easier to build more homes, including the types of homes that families, young professionals and first-time buyers can afford.
Through Neighborhood Homes for All of Us, the City is creating opportunities for more small-scale neighborhood homes in single-family neighborhoods with strong access to quality jobs, education, transit and other amenities.
Learn more about Neighborhood Homes for All of Us: https://www.sandiego.gov/planning/neighborhood-homes-all-us
